tei:div.tei:p: grub thob o rgyan pa'i lo rgyus/

༄༅/ /de dag las sku skye ba phyi ma'i 'dren par bsngags shing bstan pa gtad pa ni/ grub thob o rgyan pa yin te/ de'i gdung rabs ni mdo smad dbyar mo thang rgyus che byang chub gzhon nu bya ba byung*/ de ni slob dpon pad+ma'i dngos slob ma dang*/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan kyi mchod gnas su gyur pa zhig go /de'i sras byang chub mchog /de'i sras byang chub yon tan/ de la sras byang chub rgya mtsho dang*/ chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba gnyis byung ba de gnyis kyis g.yog po rdo rje kun thub khrid nas dbus gtsang du byon/ myong smad pa nam du sleb pa'i tshe/ ar tsho ban de bco brgyad kyis khong dpon g.yog gsum bzung*/ mkha' 'gro'i mchod rdzas byed zer nas rkang lag phur pa la brgyangs/ der kun thub na re/ da khyed gnyis la grub rtags yod na ston pa'i dus la bab zer/ gcung po na re/ ngas phur pa'i 'khrab shon cig bya'am zer/ gcen gyis 'jigs mi dgos kyi/ zer te/ dpal rta mgrin du byas nas rta skad thengs gsum bsgrags pas/ de thams cad brgyal nas brgyal sangs pa dang*/ de rnams kyis gus pas btud/ yang dag pa'i lam la btsud/ byang chub rgya mtsho'i sras bsod nams grags/ de'i sras rgyus nag bde gshegs/ de'i sras rgyal tsha bsod nams 'phags/ de'i sras dbon jo 'phan dang*/ btsun mo dug ge ma la sras bzhi dang lcam gsum byung ba'i grub chen pa ni chung ltag y-in/ lcags pho stag gi lo la sku 'khrungs/ mtshan seng ge dpal du gsol/ byis pa'i dus nas ting nge 'dzin rang 'khrungs su byung bas dgongs pa la/ dang po thos pa byas/ de nas bsgom pa bya ste da lta'i sems 'di dang khyad ci 'dug lta dgos dgongs pa byung*/ dgung lo bdun pa la yab chos ma phur dang bde dgyes sogs la mkhas par mdzad/ yab kyis btsun mo cig len zer bas khu bo'i drung du byon/ nga chos rang byed 'dod pa yin te/

phas chung ma len zer byas nas mang du bshums pas khu bos dbug phyung*/ der lo bdun nas bcu drug gi bar du/ ma phur/ bde dgyes/ phyag rdor/ yo ga la sogs pa'i rgyud 'grel sgrub thabs phyag len dang bcas pa gsan zhing mkhas par bslabs/ de nas dgung lo bcu drug pa la bo dong er byon/ chos rje rin po chen rtse mo gong ma la mkhas par sbyangs/ zhag gsum la gzhung phyed zin zhag gsum po'i gzhung skyor zhig gsung ba na phyed po bskyar/ de man yang thugs la bkra lam me 'dug nas 'di man ma bzung ba'i gzhung lags byas nas bskyar bas/ sprul pa'i sku la slob gnyer bya ma dgos par 'dug gsungs/ gzhan yang dbu tshad byams chos mtha' dag sbyangs/ rtsod pa bzang ba'i mchog tu grags/ de nas chos rje rgod tshang pa bde chen stengs nas spyang lung du 'byon pa'i lam go lung pu ru gdan phebs pa la/ chos rje rgod tshang pas de ring las can zhig dang 'phrad 'ong gsungs pa'i lung bstan mdzad pa bzhin mjal ma thag tshad las 'das pa'i dad pa skyes/ spu trar phebs dus zangs gcig dang*/ bur tong gcig la phyag rten byas/ chang dang rtsa ba bzhi bsrung ba'i dge bsnyen mdzad pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ slob dpon jo sras/ da ni btsun pa dang khyad med sdom pa thub pa dka'o/ /'o na yang khong gis thub thub/ khong skye ba snga ma btsun pa zhig yin ang*/ rgad po kho de zhes zhig po byang dpal la gsungs/ chos rjes ka ra snyims pa phyur ba gang gnang byung ba rdzogs par gsol bas rten 'brel yang 'grig /chos rje'i zhal nas khyed lan cig nga'i rtsar 'ong dgos/ ngas phyag rgya chen po bstan pas grol ba la tshegs med gsungs/ de nas/ go lung pa mdo sde dpal la 'grel chung gsan/ 'dul ba'i skor rnams gzigs pas bag chags 'thug par 'dug cing*/ khyad par las brgya rtsa gcig pa gzigs pa tsam gyis thugs la byung*/ dgung lo nyi shu lon pa'i tshe/ po dong rin rtses mkhan po/

zhang bsam gling pas slob dpon/ slob dpon bsod nams 'od zer gyis gsang ston mdzad nas gcig car bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan rin chen dpal du gsol/ de nas lo bcu gnyis su stan gcig pa'i brtul zhugs gzung zhing sha yang mi gsol/ chos rje rin rtse la dus 'khor 'bro lugs legs par zhus/ go lung pa la dus 'khor chags lugs legs par bslabs/ rtsis la sbyangs shing mkhas par mkhyen/ khong gi gsung gis dus 'khor ba sangs rgyas rdo rje tsa mi lugs la mkhas pas nyon gsung nas zla ba bcu gcig tu phran dang bcas pa gsan/ der khong chos bcag nas ser chags la byon pa la thugs cung zad skyo nas dam pa la gsol ba btab pas/ mnal lam du mjal zhing lung yang bstan/ de rnams tshar nas bde chen steng du chos rje rgod tshang pa'i sar mjal du byon pas dgon par phebs pa tsam gyis ro gcig gi rtogs pa 'khrungs/ chos rje'i drung du bka' brgyud kyi gdams pa mtha' dag gsan zhing ji lta ba bzhin du thugs la 'khrungs/ skabs shig tu bdag sham+bha lar dus kyi 'khor lo'i dka' phreng ma bde ba rnams gcod pa la 'gro bsams pa yod zhus pas/ sham+bha lar las kyi 'brel pa med/ las 'brel u rgyan du yod der byon gsungs/ ma bde ba ci 'dra yod gsungs pa la/ 'di 'dra yod byas nas 'ga' zhig zhus pas/ lan ji lta ba bzhin du gnang byung der ha las te chos rje rin po ches dus 'khor ni ma gsan/ 'di 'dra ba'i mkhas pa 'ong ba tsugs lags zhus pas/ gsung gis/ shri rir bsdad dus bud med dmar mo gcig gis po ti zhig byin/ de med pa'i snang ba byung bas/ bod du 'gyur pa'i chos la mi shes pa med gsungs/ 'o na bdag la dus 'khor gyi dbang zhig kyang gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon jo btsun rang gsol ba thob la rmi lam zung zhig gsung nas/ gsol ba btab pas rmi lam du chos rje rin po che dus 'khor ba sangs rgyas rdo rje'i cha byad du mdzad nas/

dus 'khor gyi dbang rgyas pa zhig gnang byung sang de spyan sngar byon pas/ slob dpon jo btsun thugs tshim mam gsungs/ shin tu tshim lags/ de 'dra ba'i phyag len mkhas pa su la bslab zhus pas/ mkha' 'gro mas bslab pa yin gsungs/ rje ras chung pa yin pa'i lung bstan yang gnang*/ mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo dang*/ khro bo sngon po la sogs pa'i rten 'brel ngo mtshar ba mang po yang byung de steng u rgyan du 'gro bar zhus nas dang por byang mi med kyi ri la sgrub pa la byon/ thugs dam shin tu 'phel bas sngar gyi chos brjed pa thams cad sos/ ti ser byon te phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med kyi don thugs la 'khrungs/ ngan rtog gi rgyun bcad/ pu hrang du jo bo'i bla mchod mdzad de mngon shes dang ldan par grags/ de nas grogs mched lngas/ ku lu ta dang*/ ma ru'i gnas su/ nyin re nyi ma bdun bdun gyi lam bcad de byon/ zhing skyong bud med sna nas mar khu 'dzag pa zhig gis bzhugs par zhus kyang ma bzhed de/ de'i tshe ye shes ḍā ki'i rdo rje'i glu gsan*/ de nas ri bo chen po ga ngha lar byon zhing bzhugs/ de nas dza lan+dha rar byon/ la gu ra dang*/ dza la mu khe dang*/ mi tra sā ra la sogs pa gzigs/ klu sgrub phug tu grub thob cig dang mjal/ chos kyi gsung gleng mang po byas/ de nas gzhan phyir bslog /dpal ye dang 'grogs nas byon/ nub gcig grong khyer chen po de la thal byung du song*/ shes pa za zi ban bun lus zag med du gyur/ grong de rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i pho brang dus gyur 'dug lan gcig bar chad kyi cho 'phrul g.yang zhig la lhung nas/ tshems rag rug tu chag pa la mkha' 'gro mas 'khrul 'khor gnang ste 'phral du dngas/ de nas nyin re la zla ba phyed kyi lam bcad de byon pas/ rkang mgyogs grub pa'i grags pa thob/ mu stegs pa dang*/ sog po'i nye bar 'tshe ba rnams zil gyis mnan te/

chu tsan dha bha ga brgal/ grong khyer chen po pra hā ra mi khyim 'bum phrag bdun cu yod pa gzigs/ ra tsa hur du 'bras chan grog ma dang 'bur gyur pa dang*/ chu bo sin+dhu'i 'gram du gnam sa bla 'og 'gyur ba dang*/ dus re la rnag mang du skyugs pa la sogs cho 'phrul mang du byung*/ de nas chu bo sin+dhu brgal te/ rim gyis i lo par pa ta zhes bya ba'i ri la/ chos kyi phung po mtha' dag bzhugs pa dang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa 'dus shing tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa dang*/ grub thob rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mang du bzhugs pa gzigs shing*/ ri'i khar sngon rgyal po in+d+ra bud+dhir gyur pa gsal bar dran gsungs/ de dang mi ring ba na/ slob dpon la ba pa'i rdo gdugs yod de/ der ḍā ki mas rgyal po in+d+ra bud+dhi yin zhes lung ston pa byung*/ de nas o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing dhu ma tha lar/ ka 'ong ka'i grong du bud med cig gis thug pa phor gang byin pa gsol bas dro skad cig la lus mi 'dra ba bcu drug blangs pa'i snang ba sogs rigs drug gi gnas sbyong du ma byung*/ shes pa za zir song rig pa ngos bzung du mi btub pa byung*/ 'khrul pa'i snang log la 'di byung dang 'di ma byung bya ba med de sangs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gzi brjid nyi ma'i snying po ltar 'bar ba dang mjal/ rdo rje bsnyen sgrub kyi don thugs la shar zhing*/ zhal gyi gdam pa seng ge'i 'o ma lta bu gnang*/ rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi dgongs pa thams cad rtogs/ rtsa gnas kyi mdud pa mtha' dag grol/ bag chags kyi rtog pa thams cad rang sar yal/ nang rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba mngon sum du mthong*/ lus 'di ni zag med rdo rje'i lus su gyur 'dug gsungs/ dhu ma tha la'i nub na ka ma ta ko'i gangs la/ dpal bde mchog mngon sum du bzhugs pa gzigs/ rgyal po in+d+ra bud+dhis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang du/

gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro sprin ltar du 'du zhing*/ theg pa sna tshogs kyi chos gsung ba byung*/ de nas la ba pa'i phug tu sngon gyi skye ba dran zhing*/ tshur lam dur khrod gtum drag gi skor/ 'byung po'i gnod pa bsal zhing*/ ra me shwa ra'i gnas kyang gzigs/ de nas kha che'i yul du byon/ shrī na ga ra'i grong khyer 'bum phrag sum cu yod pa dang*/ wan+ti pur du phebs/ po dzi bha rar paṇ+ḍi ta bhū mi shrī sogs la chos zhus shing*/ kha che'i rgyal pos gsod mi sum cu tsam zhig btang ba dang lam du phrad kyang grogs mched gnyis ka ci'ang ma nyes par/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam pa mdzad de byon/ slar yang dza lan+dha ra nas byon te/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dgu gzigs/ bde sdug gi rkyen la ro snyoms mdzad/ zab lam bsnyen sgrub kyi man ngag lon/ tshogs gnyis kyi bre kha phyur bur gang*/ nges med kyi rten 'brel mngon du gyur/ zag med kyi mngon shes ci rigs shar te/ sngar dpal rgod tshang pa'i zhal nas/ lo bcu gnyis na mnyam rjes med pa'i rtogs pa 'char gsung ba de 'di la dgongs par 'dug gsungs/ de nas mnga' ris su/ bla chen de khyim gyis spyan drangs shing dus gcig la/ gces phrug brgya rab tu byung zhing*/ chibs brgya la sogs pa'i zhabs tog du ma byas/ sras kyi dngos grub kyang gnang*/ de nas byon pa'i lam du/ rje rgod tshang pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor te/ nam mkha' la gshegs pa gziḍa shing gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma yid bzhin nor bu la// zhen med mos gus kyis gsol ba thob// gdams ngag yid bzhin nor bu la// zhen med yid ches kyis nyams su long*// rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu la// zhen med ro mnyam du yon tan spel// snying rje yid bzhin nor bu la// zhen med rlabs chen gyi gzhan don mdzod// ces gsung ste gshegs/ yang de'i tho rangs kha/ sprul pa'i 'gro don mtha' ru phyung*// rdo rje gling du mdzad pa btul//

yongs su dag pa'i gang zag la// gshegs dang bzhugs pa ga la yod// ces nam mkha' las grags te/ chos rje rgod tshang ba sku 'da' bar mkhyen/ btsad po la sogs pa'i 'khor dang longs spyod thams cad bor te byon/ rta sgo'i gangs su bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dpal rgod tshang ba yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa gzigs te/ de ltar gnas chen mtha' dag bskor ba'i lam glu mgur du bzhengs pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang chen rgod tshang pa/ /pha thams cad mkhyen pas byin gyis rlobs/ /nga bod gangs can gyi sprang po u rgyan pa/ /phyogs med kyi ri la pha yul byas/ /mtshan ldan bla mas rjes su bzung*/ /lus srog chos kyi phyogs su btang*/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags/ /byang mi med kyi thang la zla dgu phyin/ /'tsho ba chu rdel gnyis la byas/ /nya sha khrom gsum rus khu zos/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags/ /nub gangs dkar gyi rgyal po ti ser phyin/ /ras pa lnga brgya'i nang du bsgoms/ /chos sde snod kun la mkhas gyur kyang*/ /mkhas pa'i dregs pa nga la med/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags/ / gangs de nas zla gcig nub tu lam/ /ri bo chen po gan+dha la/ /sman sum brgya drug cu sa la skyes/ /dgos ru rta'i nags tshal 'thib pa yod/ /ru rta rdog po gcig kyang khyer ba med/ / pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags/ /ri de nas zla phyed lho ru lam/ /gnas dza lan+dha ra'i pho brang na/ /zong 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i tshong 'dus yod/ /nor snying sdug gcig kyang khyer ba med/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags/ /gnas de nas zhag grangs nyi shu'i nub/ /chu tsadha bha ga'i shar phyogs na/ /tshos rgya skyegs kyi thang la nyin lam phyin/ /ngas lci le gcig kyang khyer ba med/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags// chu de nas zla gcig nub tu lam/ /na'u dri sman tsha'i ri bo yod/ /sman tsha rdog po gcig kyang khyer ba med/

/pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags/ /de nas zhag gsum nub tu lam/ /mkhar ma la ko tri yi grong khyer yod/ /rin chen mu tig 'byung ba rgya mtsho'i sgo/ / sman rtsi bo che de sa la skye ba yod/ /ngas ni rtsi yang khyer ba med/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags/ / grong de nas zla gcig nub tu lam/ /chu sin+dhu brgal ba'i nub kyi phyogs/ /ka bo ka yi grong khyer na/ /rdzas sin+dhu ra 'byung ba'i pho brang yod/ /ngas gri kha gcig kyang khyer ba med/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags/ /sa de nas zhag bdun nub tu lam/ /kha rag khar rna'i i lo la/ /rgun 'brum gyi nags tshal 'thibs pa yod/ / ngas rdzas la zhen pa byas pa med/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags// sa de nas zhag bzhi nub tu phyin/ / rdo reg pa med pa'i nub phyogs na/ /chu ko taṃ bha ra'i byang gi phyogs/ /gangs ka ma dha ka'i shar phyogs na/ /gnas o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing khams chags/ /gnas gsum kyi mkha' 'gro mi gzugs bzung*/ /thogs pa med pa'i longs spyod can/ /ngas 'dod yon la ched du bzung ba med/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags/ /gnas de nas zla gcig shar du lam/ /dur khrod gtum drag lha yi char/ / 'bru bdag po med pa su dga' 'khyer/ /rgyags phye bre gang yang khyer ba med/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags//

gnas de nas zhag bzhi shar du lam/ /ra me shwa ra smin pa'i gnas/ /sprang khyim du gso zhing chang du 'tshod/ /ngas zan spags gcig kyang khyer ba med/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags/ /gnas de nas zla gcig shar du lam/ /yul kha che khri gtan wan ti pur/ /sman gur gum zhing du skye ba yod/ /ngas ge sar gcig kyang khyer ba med/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags/ /yul de nas zla gcig shar du lam/ /bla chen de khyim gyi bla mchod byas/ /rta 'ol ba 'jag ma'i thang la rgyab/ /gos dar chen dug po'i lhan par btab/ /dngul bre chen bye ma'i gling la bor/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags// sa de nas zla gcig shar du lam/ /byang gu lang gser kas sna drangs nas/ /rgya bod kyi gser kha mang du phyin/ /gser ra ti gcig kyang khyer ba med/ /pho zhen log can tshogs pa'i yang rtse lags/ /zhes so// de nas rdo rje gling du byon te/ /chos rje rin po che mi bzhugs dbyings su gshegs/ / zhes pa la sogs pa gsung zhing*/ spyan chab phyung*/ phyag mang du btsal/ de nub dpal rgod tshang pa'i zhal nas/ bu mos gus bskyed la bya'i lo la rdo rje gdan du rgyug /dag sbyor 'phel po yong*/ zhes pa dang*/ yang 'gro bzang 'chi bar 'dug pas der bshol du 'dong gsung ba byung ste/ der byon zhing gsung gleng mdzad/ bshol ba'i rten 'brel ma 'grig /de nas gdan sa rdo rje gling*/ spu tra/ dga' ldan gling*/ steng 'gro rnams su/ chos rje'i sku tshab dang*/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ mchod pa'i bkod pas mdzes par byas/ bar 'brog gla ba mkhar du/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ma zhal gzigs/ nam mkha' las sgra byung ste/ kye skyes bu khyod bir wa pa yin no bya ba dang*/ lwa ba pa yin no bya ba dang*/ nag po spyod pa yin no bya ba byung*/ yang nub cig /rnal 'byor pa khyod ras chung rdo rje grags pa yin te/ khyod la 'khor khri phrag dgu yod ces pa nam mkha' la grags pa byung*/

yang rnal lam du ḍā ki mas/ hā swā ra maḍa ḍa ko ma k+ṣa ra sa aṃ/ zhes bya ba'i rims srung gi sngags phul/ dpal ldan lha mo'i zhal gzigs/ yul der nad yams yod pa chad/ yang sems can 'obs la sgom 'debs pa yang mdzad/ de nas lcags mo bya lo la dpon slob mang po rgya gar rdo rje gdan du 'byon par brtsams te/ bal yul thang ka mer mgon po phyag bzhi pas bsu ba byas/ ye rong gi mtha' khyab na/ 'bras rdung ba'i bu mo dag gis rdo rje'i glu blangs pa gsan/ ti ra hu tir raṃ shing rgyal po la brtul zhugs mdzad/ mu stegs kyi lha khang dang rten la yang brtul zhugs mdzad de/ rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs/ byang chub kyi shing mchog tu mdzes pa'i drung du/ mi bzod pa'i dad pa drag pos so phag gi thang la sku lus drag tu brdabs shing dbu thod 'gas pa 'dra ba'i phyag btsal bas/ rlung sems a ba dhū tir tshud/ bdag gzhan brje nus pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che thugs la 'khrungs/ de nas mchu zla ba'i bco lnga la srin po rnams ma hā bo dhi'i drung du 'ong zhes grags pas/ ltad mo mdzad par dgongs pa'i tshe/ tshogs bdag glang snas phyag 'tshal zhing phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na bcom ldan 'das sku bltams pa'i bkod pa la/ dad pa'i blos rkyen byas nas/ rje rgod tshang pa steng phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su/ sangs rgyas ma chags pad+ma'i spyan du gyur pa na/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin du skyes nas zhabs tog byed par smon lam btab gsungs/ dzñā na gar+bha sogs bzhis ma hā bodhi'i drung du smon lam btab pas/ mgon pos bskul ba ltar gar log gi dmag bzlog /dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal gyi mtsho zhig la gnas pa'i klu bdud de dam la btags shing*/ dus de nas drag po'i phrin las rnams bsil ba tshal gyi gzhi bdag des bsgrub pa yin no// de nas bod phyogs su byon pa'i lam du/

chu la mi 'bying ba dang*/ stag la rengs pa'i sbyor ba la sogs mdzad cing*/ bde chen steng du rje rgod tshang pa'i zhal nas/ da ni 'gro don dus la bab pa yin no/ /zhes lung ston pa byung yang rnal lam du ḍoṃm+bh-i he ru kar gyur pa dang*/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i zhal gzigs pa dang*/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi tshogs 'khor bskor ba'i gral du byon pas/ lwa ba pa dang dbyer med du gzigs pa sogs byung*/ rje nyid bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas seng ge sgrar zhal gyis bzhes/ snye nam dga' ldan gling du chos rje'i sku tshab bzhengs pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten gyi longs spyod la dgug pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pa sogs grub rtags du ma bstan zhing*/ snye nam gyi dbu ma pas/ rgod tshang pa la ngan smras byed pa btul/ ding rir phebs pa na jo bo bu le'i bsu ba rta pa'i tshogs lung pa gang ba byung*/ go lung pa mjal du byon pa'i tshe/ rnal 'byor pho mo sum brgya tsam gyis shangs len gyi mchod pa byed pa'i sar/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsungs pas thams cad nyams 'ur zhing mthar ting nge 'dzin du song*/ de'i dus gdul bya'i rten 'brel dang mngon par shes pa mang du gsungs/ sku bsod dpag tu med pa byung ba la/ dpon byin rdor na re/ o rgyan pa la dbang bsdud yod par 'dug zer ba la/ 'dod chags dag pa'i bde stong 'di/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i srog snying yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ de'i tshe rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub kyis rin po che mkhar chu ba sogs skal ldan dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod de/ ngas bsnyen sgrub kyi khrid btab na lung pa grub thob kyis 'gengs par 'dug ste/ rang gi khams la'ang cung zad gzan zhing*/ bka' brgyud rin po che gong ma'i khrid srol la cung zad gnod par 'dug gsung nas/ phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa'i khrid chen la gtso bor mdzad/ de'i dus su zhal mthong ba dang bkas bkyon pa dang*/

phyag lcag gnang ba dang*/ thugs gtad pa tsam gyis nad gdon las grol ba dpag tu med pa byung*/ bde chen du brtan ma bcu gnyis kyis stod hor zlog par gsol ba btab pas rim gro dang smon lam mdzad/ rdo rje dpal gyis hor dmag khrid 'ongs pa kho rang lam du shi nas dmag rnams log /rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i pi wang gi sgra gsan pas 'dzin bzang bar gyur kyang*/ ri sgog cung zad bzhes pas de ma thag brjed ngas par song bas/ phag dkar gyi sgrub pa mdzad/ de'i tshe dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge rnams zhal du thim zhing phag mo dkar po 'od kor gyi nang du bzhugs pa'i zhal gzigs/ dbu ma pa'i slob ma phug pa rgyal rdor gyis mthu byed zer ba dgongs pas sang nyin khong rang drung du sleb byung bar/ nga'i zan kham re po 'di mis byin pa ma yin/ lha 'dres byin pa yin/ lha 'dres bzar btub na o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing du nyin mo bud med du yod pa rnams/ mtshan mo byi la dang stag gzig la sogs par gyur nas mig dmar lcig lcig pa dpag tu med pa yod de/ de rnams kyis kyang bzar ma btub pa zhig yin/ khyod kyi chos skyong rnams nga'i rkang pa sa la brdab pa tsam gyis brlag 'gro/ nga'i gnyid thams cad 'od gsal du yod de/ las sbyor thams cad rmi lam du rdzogs 'gro ba yin gsungs/ khos kyang nus pa'i bsnyems kyis gus 'dud ma byas par srung 'khor bsgom pas 'khor bcas myur du brlag par gyur/ de nas spu trar thugs bskyed gsungs pa'i tshe/ 'od kor nang du spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gzigs/ slar yang bla chen de khyim gyis zhabs tog dpag tu med pa byas/ skyi rong shel rir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma byin rlabs tshad med pa'i snang ba gzigs/ byang phyogs lcang lo can du rje btsun ras chung ba bzhugs/ khyod de'i sprul pa yin te/ yar sdud pa yin zhes 'od zer cig byung ba de la 'jus na de'u phyin byas/

res bir wa pa/ res la ba pa/ res in+d+ra bud+dhi sna tshogs yin zer/ gang yin nam snyam pa la/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhal nas/ spyod pa yul thog tu ro snyoms pa bir wa pa yin/ gnyid 'od gsal du tshud pas lwa ba pa yin/ 'dod chags bde stong du shar bas in+d+ra bud+dhi yin/ de rnams dang khyod dbyer mi phyed gsungs/ yang khyod skye ba 'di'i phyi ma la/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'od dang ba zhes bya bar 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rin chen dbyangs zhes bya bar 'gyur/ de'i phyi ma la yang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po zhig tu 'gyur*/ de'i phyi ma la lha'i dbang po brgya byin du skyes nas rgyal ba'i zhabs tog byed par 'gyur zhes lung ston pa byung*/ de dus rdo rje gdan gyi lcags ri gar log gis bshig pa/ dzña na gar+bha la longs spyod pa mang po bskur te/ zangs gling gi rgyal po dang*/ ya tshe'i rgyal po dang*/ grub chen pa rnams kyis phyogs re re nas gsos te byang sgo la bod kyi sgor grags pa byung*/ dus de nas mya ngan las ma 'das kyi bar gser dngul sogs dngos po gang byung thams cad rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag khang gi mthun rkyen dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad du bskur ba mdzad/ spud trar rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī na ren+d+ras thog drangs rgya bod kyi rnal 'byor pho mo lnga brgya tsam la dus 'khor gyi dbang bskur bas ye shes kyi byin chen po pheb pa byung*/ bla ma go lung pa sku gshegs nas de'i gshegs rdzong sgrub par mdzad/ bal po rdzong gi shar phyogs kyi 'gal sor 'byung po 'dul byed zhal gzigs/ 'byung po'i gtso bo brgyad kyis thun mong gi dngos grub phul/ mang yul kos kar sug tu/ rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub yi ger 'god par/ rnal 'byor mas mngon sum du rjes su gnang*/ hor rgyal po se chen gyis bod la lam byas nas bal po dang*/ dmag 'dren pa'i lam lta ba'i gser yig pa btang byung ba la/

chu bo rabs kyi phreng ba mdzad/ rgyal po la bstod pa sdeb sbyor can mdzad nas dmag gis lam mi bgrod par don gyis bka' gnang bas dmag shol te/ rgya bal bod gsum 'jigs pa las bskyabs kyang 'di lta bu'i bka' drin du go mkhan yang cher mi snang*/ slar yang bod bdun cu tsam khrid nas rgya gar rdo rje gdan du byon pa'i lam/ bal po rdzong du sho gam par nus pa bstan/ grong khyer de hi ra dang nye bar chom rkun rengs par mdzad/ chu bo gaṅga'i 'gram du tshogs bdag rta dkar por sprul nas bsu ba byas/ rdo rje gdan du mchod pa'i yo byad du mas mchod/ de'i tshe dzo ki lnga brgyas tshogs 'khor byas tshad kyi tshog gral du mi re shi bas byed ma nus pa na/ tshogs dpon du spyan drangs pas thams cad la byin rlabs zhugs/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sna tshogs par mthong nas rtsod med kyi grub thob chen por bkur/ rgyal sras man lung pa lho phyogs be ta'i yul du byon pa'i rim gror rgyal ba'i sku gdung la/ sku khrus gsol zhing 'dug pa'i tshe mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob nas/ bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa mdzad/ rgyal bu thams cad sgrol gyis bzhugs pa'i gnas/ ri bo a yang ga par pa ta gzigs shing*/ lam gyi nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zil gyis mnan nas bod phyogs su byon te/ cal bhe go bya bar bu mo zhig shi ba slong bar mdzad/ skyi rong nags su/ bzo mo drug cu tsam gyis chang mang du drangs shing gsol ba'i tshe/ bho ṭa paṇ+ḍi tas skur pa btab par kho rang la chad skyugs pa'i sbyor ba mdzad/ ri bo shar gangs kyi mgul du/ bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis zhal gzigs nas/ der grub chen nyid kyi dbu bcad nas 'bul ba'i snang ba byung*/ yang rnal lam du rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma/ sge phreng*/ dpal sgron/ nyang shes rab 'byung gnas/ nyang ston rdo rje snying po rnams dang rim par mjal chos gsungs/ rdo rje snying po'i zhal nas/

zag med bde chen gar gyi rol pa la// mnyam nyid lhun grub bde ba chen por rdzogs// khyab brdal lhun gnas dran rtog rig pa'i mdangs// mnyam gnas bde chen bya rtsol bral ba rdzogs// dmigs med kun khyab gar yang mi bden pa// rig pa sna tshogs cir yang 'char ba rdzogs// zhes gsungs ste/ /rdzogs chen gyi yig cha yang mdzad do// de'i tshe las chen bcu gnyis kyi dbye ba'i las/ gdul bya rnams la bstan zhing*/ /sa skya'i dpon chen kun bzang gis phyag na la dug blud pa mkhyen pa'i gtam kun bzang khong rang gi thos nas/ spud trar dmag byas/ gzims khang bshig pas ltas ngan mang po byung*/ bka' chad kyis lo lnga nas kho pa rjes med du brlag /slar rgyal bu a rog ches yon bdag byas nas sbud tra'i dgon pa gsos/ sngon li'i rgyal po rdo rje gzhon nur gyur pa dang*/ u rgyan du gsum/ sham bha lar gnyis/ bod du gcig /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du skye ba bdun/ gzhan skye ba dpag med pa dran gsungs/ de'i tshe stod tsan gyis dbang zhus par/ bum pa nam mkha' la chags/ bla ma 'phags pa rgya yul nas 'khor ba dang*/ sa skyar zhal 'dzom mdzad/ chu mig ring mor khrom la dgug pa'i sbyor ba mdzad/ de nas shang du pheb/ dge bshes rmog cog pa dang*/ nyi ma lung pa/ spos dkar ba/ dge sdings pa/ phu chung ba sogs kyis rang rang gi gnas su spyan drangs bsnyen bkur byas/ gyad pa rnams kyis tsha ti zlum po'i dgon pa phul nas der bzhugs/ phyogs de'i sdig rgyun bcad/ de nas yar sbud trar phebs/ dpon chen byang rin na bar spyan drangs nas 'jang du phebs/ dpon chen grongs pa'i ser 'tshogs kyi gral dbu mdzad/ snar thang rig ral la tshad ma'i lung gsan/ grub chen gyis nga gsum bzhes pa chu rta lor dbus kyi 'gro don la byon/ mtshur phur chos rje karma pa dang mjal te thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ lha sar mi dpon zor ko kun dga' rgyal po la brtul zhugs mdzad/

g.yon po gra'i snye ma dor snye mdo chen po la zhi byed rgyud phyi'i skor gsan/ bsam yas su bstan rtsis kyi yi ge mdzad/ phag mo gru dang*/ g.yu ru khra 'brug dang*/ gtsang zhal rnams su phebs/ bla ma snye mdo ba sogs mang por dus 'khor dang bde mchog sogs kyi dbang rgyud man ngag mang po gnang*/ g.ye rong du thang srin dang*/ yar lha sham bo la sogs pa du mas bsu ba byas/ phrin las rgya chen po byung*/ gnyal smad du bya rin chen dang*/ te'u ra bas spyan drangs/ brag sna thang du skye bo khri phrag bdun tsam la sems bskyed gnang*/ lha gsum mkhar du chom rkun rjes su bzung*/ te'u ra'i gnas gog pa gsor bcug cing*/ rgyal po zla ba'i go chas rab gnas byas pa'i gser phye bum pa gzigs/ lo ror nye ba'i mtshams med spyod pa rnams bzlog ste/ byang chub kyi lam la bkod do// mon mtsho snar mon gyi rgyal pos btud cing*/ de'i tshe chos rje rin po che karma pa na bza' ber nag dang*/ dbu zhwa nag po bsnams sku gzi mdangs dpag tu med pa dang bcas/ chibs pa nag po cig la bcibs te/ shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' la byon te/ bzhugs par gsol ba btab kyang ma gnang ba byung*/ de chos rje bde bar gshegs pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ de nas sham po'i gangs mgul du/ slob ma rnams kyis yun ring du bzhugs par zhus pas/ nga lus zung 'jug lha skur brtan/ ngag grags stong 'dzin med du shar/ sems 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med pa chos kyi skur grol nas rgyal khams mang por phyin/ mi rigs mang po bltas/ nor rigs mang po bsdus/ kha zas kyi rigs mang po sngar yang zos pa yin/ da'ang sa gcig tu bsdad na chags sdang 'ong bas gzhi mi 'dzin/ sngar yang dgon pa mang po zhig btab ste bor ba yin/ bu slob grwa pa yang phyogs gcig tu bsdus na mang du 'ongs te ched du ma bzung*/ nga thod pa 'di rgya gar du skyol nas rtsad khungs med par shi na shin tu bzang*/
slob dpon grongs zer nas slob ma rnams kyis zan gong re tsam gyis shid byed pa la dgos pa ci yang med/ de'i phyir nga sdod snying 'dod na sdod/ 'gro snying 'dod na 'gro /

'dir 'gro ba'i gtad pa med/ gar dgar 'gro /ci dgar byed pa yin/ 'chi ba la'ang de tsam skyon du mi blta/ de'i phyir nga shi na shin tu bde ba yin gsungs/ de nas yar lam lca ba lung du/ rgyal gyi zla ba la mchod pa zhig mdzad pa'i tshe/ gtad med du zil chen po byung skad cig de nyid la/ chos rje rin po che karma pa na bza' dang dbu zhwa nag po gsol/ gzi brjid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar 'bar ba/ bar snang la mngon sum du byon nas/ zhwa nag zhig gnang ba byung*/ de'i zil gyis drung na yod pa'i mi thams cad brgyal ba ltar gyur/ rje nyid la dad pa'i stobs kyis spyan chab mang du byon/ de'i tshe/ 'gyur med rang byung rdo rje'i sku// rnam dag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// chos sku dri med gdan la bzhugs// snying po mchog gi brgyud pa 'dzin// zhes bya ba la sogs pa tsheg bar bdun pa'i bstod pa dang*/ rgyun chags kyi bstod pa yang mdzad/ gar pheb kyi sa de dag tu rten gsum la mchod pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos kyi phrin las dang*/ ngo mtshar gyi grub rtags bstan pa'i tshul sogs ni brjod kyis mi lang*/ de ltar dbus gtsang gi gdul bya rnams smin par mdzad nas/ la stod spud trar phebs/ jo btsun byin dor shi ba'i shul ma rnams kyis dmag byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis zhi bar mdzad/ nyang ro'i dge bshes dpon slob rnams kyis mjal bas ye shes mgon por mthong*/ dge bshes kyi gcung po la chag l+h+wam brgyab pas rtogs pa skyes/ bde chen steng du shong lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan la lhan skyes sbyor sogs kyi khrid gnang*/ rgya gar gyi mu stegs pa 'ga' zhig kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan par bcug/ de nas se chen rgyal po'i gdan 'dren mi chen e ji lag byung ba 'byon du ma gnang*/ de rjes go ron che gdan 'dren du byung ba la yang ma gnang*/ yang dus phyis mi chen thog thi mur gdan 'dren du byung ba la yang ma byon pas/

de na re stobs kyis bzung nas khyer ba yin zer ba la/ phyag lcag brdab bka' bkyon drag tu mdzad pas khros nas song*/ gong du sleb dus nyes pa lag tu gtugs skad/ yang phyis mi chen ne gu ta zhes bya ba gdan 'dren du byung bas/ sngon rdo rje gdan du mi dkar po zhig na re/ dus phyis hor gyi rgyal pos khyed gdan 'dren bar 'gyur gyi/ de'i gsung ma bcag /rgyal po de ni bsod nams tshad med pa dang ldan te/ rdo rje gdan gyi mchod rten 'di rnams kyang des bzhengs pa yin zhes lung ston pa byung*/ mi de spyan ras gzigs su 'dug /da ni na so rgas kyang 'gro ba yin/ sang phod da tsam 'dir sleb pa yin gsungs/ de nas chu pho 'brug gi lo/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa gsum pa la/ dpon slob dgu bcu rtsa bdun tsam gyis bteg /lha sar phebs pa'i tshe/ gu ru chos dbang gi sras pos gter nas bton pa'i tshe chu phyag tu byung*/ mtshal gung thang du dpon dga' bde dpal gyis spyan drangs/ gong nas myur du yar pheb pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig par mdzad/ stag lung pas bsnyen bkur chen pos mchod/ mdo khams la sogs lam na yod pa'i skye bo thams cad byang chub kyi lam la bkod de/ shing kun tu gong ma nas phebs bsu+u ba gnang zhing dpon slob thams cad kyis na bza' rgya lugs su brjes/ de phyin chad du grong khyer thams cad nas rgyal po'i lung gis bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas nas theg rgyang ring nas ri bo rtse lnga gzigs pa/ ma zhus par mkhyen nas phyag mdzad/ pho brang chen por bsu ba'i bkod pa du ma dang bcas te phebs rgyal po dang mjal zhing*/ saṃskṛta'i skad kyis shis brjod dang bcas tshe chu rgyal po'i phyag tu phul/ ma bsgo bar gdan la bzhugs pas ma bcos pa gsungs nas rgyal po mnyes/ ro bcud kyi phyag len bstan par mdzad/ gdung ma chen po zhig bstan nas shing cir 'dug zer ba na rgya mtsho'i nya chen po zhig gi rmang ra yin gsungs pas/

rgyal pos mngon shes 'dug zer/ sa skya pa rnams thams cad la phyin pa'i nor nyams chen po 'dug zer/ rgyal po'i phyag bsnyung ba sus kyang 'chos ma thub pa de dbyug pa mdzad pas phan/ rgyal po la chos gsungs/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po'i shel tham 'bul gsung yang ma bzhes/ gong ma'i sku la dus sbyor dgu 'gags zin pas/ tshe chu dang ro bcud kyang an tsam phyis/ bsdad kyang phan mi thogs gsung nas zhu ba nan can mdzad pas 'byon pa'i lung 'khrol/ shing rta kha sprod cig gser bre dang dngul bres bkang ste phul ba blon po tsho'i blor ma shong 'u lag gis mi lcogs zer nas ma bzhes par rgyal po nyid la phul/ nga la nor gyi dgos pa med/ nga'i 'khor rnams bya bral ba yin/ de la nor gyis ci byed/ chos mi byed na ni dad can gyi rdzas mi 'ju/ nga la nor dgos na sman rtsi bo che'i las sgo sogs las sgo rin thang can dpag med dbyer yod ste ma phye/ rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i gser 'gyur byas na lcags thams cad gser du 'gyur gsungs pas/ rgyal pos gcig ston dang zer/ gsha' rtse dkar po dngul du bsgyur lcags gser du bsgyur te bstan pas ngo mtshar che ste/ nga'i mdzod chud 'dza' su la'ang ma bstan zhig zer/ mi chen du ma la bde mchog gi dbang bskur mdzad pas/ 'bul ba du ma byung ba bzhes pas rgyal po ma mnyes nas/ oḍ+yan pak+sh-i ngas bos pas mi sdod 'phral la 'gro/ nga'i 'bul ba mi len/ gzhan gyi len zer nas bka' kyon du byung ba la/ slob mas bla ma dam tshig la bkar ba gang na'ang mi 'dug /brgya byin mdun du byung rung mgo bregs la klad pa ldag bsam pa min pa nyam nga med gsungs nas/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan pas/ 'dar phri li li spyan chab phrom phrom 'dug /se chen de 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa yin zer mkhan 'dug pas/ ngas brtag pa'i phyir gsang ba'i bdag po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan pas non 'gro yin 'dug

'jam dpal min par 'dug /spyir bsod nams kyi zil chen po 'dug gsungs/ ri bo rtse lngar byon/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs/ gdul bya smin grol la bkod cing*/ sbrul lo'i lo dus su spu trar phebs/ de nas skyi rong du byon te/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po dngos kyi skur bstan/ dug gis mi tshugs pa'i sbyor ba mdzad/ gshin po dngos su 'bebs pa dang*/ bar do'i sems can ji lta ba gzigs shing*/ 'dren pa'i thabs mang du mdzad de/ yang spu tra na bzhugs pa'i tshe gzhan rkyen gyis som sod pa cig yong ba 'dra zhus pas/ bde mchog phyi rol mchod pa mdzad pa'i tshe so ma sod pa mi yong bde mchog zhal 'dzum mdzad kyin 'dug /nga dang mi lab pa bzhin yod/ gzhan gyis blor mi shong gsung ngo*/ /nang gcig snga mor bzhengs nas/ mdangs rin po che karma pa dang mjal ba rmis gsungs/ der mu phug nas gnas brtan bsrung bya ba mjal du byung ba na re/ mdangs mu phug na rdza thug byed pa'i bza' mi gsum gda'/ de'i bu de karma pa yin zer/ da nang nga dang bsdongs yongs bas mtha'i spyil po zhig tu thal lta ba lags sam zer bas/ 'o na de ga yin no da lta rang khug la shog gsungs nas gcig gdan 'dren du btang*/ la las stan mthon po brtsigs/ la las spos sreg dung thong la 'tshogs pas bsu ba gyis gsungs pas/ de ltar byas te bsu ba byas nas nang du byon pa na/ khyod karma pa yin nam gsungs pas/ phyag g.yas pa nam mkha' la brkyangs na bza' phrag la bkal nas/ da ming yongs su grags pa'i karma pa bya ba yin gsungs/ stan bshams pa'i steng du byon nas bzhugs te/ skye ba snga ma la ngas khyed la chos bshad pa yin/ da nga la khyed kyis chos shod gsungs so/ /'o na skye ba snga ma la ci byin gsungs pas/ ngas zhwa nag byin pa gsungs/ de bden nga'i gzim chung na yod long la shog gsungs/ nye gnas kyis blangs te sngon gnang ba de dbu la gsol bas thams cad bzhad gad du song ngo*//

der mchog gi sprul pa'i skur bdag rkyen phun sum tshogs par mdzad/ de'i tshe dza ye bur gyi rgyal po bud+dha se nas/ rgyal ba'i sku gdung 'bul mi btang byung ba mchod gnas su mdzad de/ phyag dang bskor ba'i khrigs sku ma 'das kyi bar du ma chag par mdzad/ nyin gcig shar phyogs nas nam mkha' la shel gyi phreng ba gcig byung nas/ nga'i stan gyi steng na 'dug /brgyud pa 'dzin pa gcig rang shar phyogs nas 'ongs pa yin nam gsungs/ yang nyin gcig nyi ma la rnal du song ma thag bzhengs nas/ nga ni byis pa chung ngu gcig tu song 'dug gsungs/ der drung na yod pa rnams kyi bsam pa la/ ro bcud kyi nus pas sku gzhon nur 'gro ba yin snyam mo// de nas dus 'khor gyi dbang zhig nag pa'i nya la mdzad nas/ smron zla'i tshes gsum la/ chos rje rin po che rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i dus mchod chen mo mdzad/ mi nyag gi mi chen pa yan do yon gyi gser yig pa sleb/ gong ma go lung rgyal pos rdo rje gdan gyi lha khang gso ba'i cha rkyen du/ dngul bre chen bcu gnyis sogs bskur ba rdo rje gdan pa mgon po rgyal mtshan gyis dbu mdzad pa'i bya btang gi sgom chen du ma rdo rje gdan du mngag nas zhabs tog 'grub par mdzad/ /de nas mi chen sa ga ta bya ba dang*/ ma'i ju bya ba sa skyar 'bul bskyel ba byung bas spyan drangs sa skyar byon/ mi chen sa ga tas tshe dbang zhus pa'i tshe mi chen khyed la tshe la bar chad chen po zhig 'dug pa dbang des sel 'dug /longs spyod la bar chad cig 'dug gsung ngo*// de nas yang g.yas ru shangs su byon/ de'i lo than pa chen po byung bas/ grub chen pa gar byon sar char chen po byung bas/ phyogs thams cad du gdan 'dren su thob byung ste skye bo rnams dbugs phyung ngo*/ /der yang gzhan sems mkhyen pa'i mngon shes du ma bstan cing bgegs 'dul ba sogs phrin las cher mdzad/ yang skyid grong du phebs ste 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang la gser thog 'gel ba'i grogs mdzad cing*/

khyim bya zhig la ro snyom gyi sgom btab/ yang spu trar 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rig gtad mdzad pa'i tshe/ lha gdong pa gzhon tshul gyis gsang ba'i bdag po dngos su mthong*/ zhabs snyung ba la khab gtsags kyis khrag bton nas sgom chen pa zhig yod pa la 'di 'thung nga skye ba bdun pa yin gsungs*/ kong po rdo ka ras pa bya bas sku'i snyan pa thos kyang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa nga rang la yod/ 'on kyang grub thob de mjal bsams nas 'ong bas/ zhal mthong ma thag pa ba spu g.yos/ dge bshes nyid la rtogs pas ci byed gsungs pas/ mos gus rang dbang med pa skyes/ nyams myong gi 'dzin pa rtsa ba nas zad/ ro snyoms kyi rtogs pa shar nas/ rje 'gran gyi do med o rgyan pa// zhal lan gcig mthong bas snang ba 'gyur// gsung thos lus kyi ba spu g.yos na yun mi ring yang*// tshe rabs kyi bla ma yin par nges// da mkhas par bslab pa brdzun du zhig/ rtogs pa zhig yod pa rmang nas sgyel// tham thum thams cad gcig tu 'dres// zhes sogs kyi mgur blangs so// de nas grub thob chen pos/ rje btsun mi la'i gdan sa brin du byon nas chos gsungs/ tshur lan bla ma rgyal mtshan 'byung gnas pas glang 'khor du gdan drangs/ bla ma de dad par mdzad cing byin gyis brlabs/ snye nam du ba lung zhes pa'i lung pa zhig gsar du dbye bar mdzad/ de'i mi ma yin rdzogs chen gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa sgos chen pa'i gzugs lnga 'dug gsungs/ ne to na bzhugs pa'i tshe sgra gcan gyi gzugs gzigs pas/ gsang bdag gi ting nge 'dzin gsal btab nas zil gyis mnan kyang*/ ma phan pas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas/ thugs dkyil gsal thebs pa dang*/ gzuḍa brnyan de rim gyis zhu song*/ sgra gcan gyi gnyen po dus 'khor du 'dug gsungs so// gzhan yang mngon par shes pa du ma mdzad cing*/ mkhan po sgrub rin la chang skyugs pa'i sbyor ba sogs mdzad/

rje rgod tshang pa dang rtogs pa mnyam par zhal gyis bzhes/ skyid grong sogs su bar do'i gzugs mang po gzigs pa'i tshul gsungs/ rdo rje gling pa'i dpon la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i dbang rgyud man ngag mang du gnang*/ slob ma la sogs pa gzhan dag gi gegs bsal ba'i tshul ni smos gyis mi lang*/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud dang gdams pa'i chos dang*/ ngo mtshar can gyi gsung gleng dang*/ 'phral gtam rnams kyang zab mo'i gnad kyis spras te byon pas/ skal ldan rnams nges shes gting nas skye/ chos gsungs pa'i tshe na'ang nye ring med pas thos pa dang*/ saṃskṛ ta dang*/ rgya gar gyi yul tha dad dang*/ ri brag pa dang*/ rgya nag dang*/ hor dang*/ yu gur dang*/ gang dang gang gi skad byung yang*/ de dang de'i gsung gleng mdzad cing*/ theg pa che chung sngags phyi nang la sogs pa dri ba rnams kyi lan 'debs so/ /gdams pa rnams la'ang lam rtags nyams myong*/ bogs 'don/ gegs sel la sogs gdul bya'i khams dang*/ dbang po bsam pa mkhyen pas sgro 'dogs thams cad chod par mdzad do// gzhan yang dbang ka lung ka man ngag gi bka' rnams gang zag nyam chung la yod na yang gus pa dang bcas te gsan par mdzad do/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus don dkyil chog sgrub thabs la sogs pa gsungs/ chos kyi rigs kyang mang du mdzad cing*/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel phran dang bcas pa mang du bzhengs nas thugs sras du ma la slob cing gnang*/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi gnad la mnga' brnyes pas nga ni rigs ldan dang mtshungs pa yin no gsungs/ bsam gtan pa'i 'tsho ba sbyor/ a tsa ra rnams la gser drug nam yan gnang*/ rdo rje gdan/ lha sa/ bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa rnams dang*/ lha khang la sogs pa gso ba la bstan pa'i zhabs tog tu phyag rdzas dpag tu med pa btang ngo*/ /gser dngul gos dar la sogs pa du ma tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu spel/ snga dro bde mchog gi phyi mchod mdzad de thugs bskyed len/

de nas thugs dam gtor ma cha bcu bdun/ thun mong ba'i cha bcu/ dzam bha la'i chu sbyin gsum sogs mdzad do// gung la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung la sku khrus dang phyag bskor ba mchod brjod mdzad do/ /dgongs mo 'khor lo sdom pa'i phyi rol mchod pa thugs bskyed/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ma chag par mdzad do/ de nas tshogs 'khor/ gsol 'debs/ rdo rje'i mgur spros med thugs 'od gsal la mnyam par 'jog pa sogs rtsa rlung la gnad du bsnun pas bde drod la dbang 'byor nas/ tsha grang dang nad gdon gang gis kyang mi gos/ tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus na/ lhun po lta bur brjid che bas/ rang mthong dregs pa can gyi hor dang*/ ma rungs pa rnams dpa' skong zhing sma phab nas zil gyi gnon par mdzad do// sgra tshad pa rin rgyal mjal du byung ba la/ spyir yang chos kyi gsung gleng dang*/ khyad par du dus 'khor gyi bum sman gyi re'u mig la skad rnyed pa rnams la bsgyur/ ma rnyed pa rnams rtsa ba lo ma 'bras bu rnams/ dbyibs ro skye tshul rnams ngo sprod dang bcas pa yod pa bstan pas/ shin tu ngo mtshar che zer nas mkhan po thar pa gling pa dang gnyis kas bris song*/ dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi ras bris bstan nas 'di dang sgrub thabs la skyon 'dug na zung zhig gsungs pas/ ltas ngo mtshar che zer/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' na las chen bcu gnyis sgrub pa'i lha yod pa 'di rnams spyir gda'/ dus 'khor nas bshad pa med zer

bas/ der brnyas thabs su bzhad nas/ khyod dus 'khor la mkhas zer te mkhas pa rang du 'dug /lha 'di rnams dus 'khor nas ma bshad pa a gsungs pas/ khong skyengs nas drung gi dpang du mgo bzhag nas/ blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs zer/ blo chos su song gda' yi gsungs/ nang par bla ma lha rje pak+shi la khar sang drung nas dus 'khor gyi sgrub thabs dang ras bris bstan nas/ skyon zung gsungs pa la/ skyon mtha' ma na las rab 'byams kyi lha 'dug pa ngo ma shes par/ 'di 'dra dus 'khor na bshad pa med byas te bla btsong*/ khong gis zil gyis non nas shes pa za zi rang dbang med pa zhig byung zer ro// dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa'i tshe yang gnyer ma mi mnga'*/ gzhon sha can/ sku yang shing gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa lags so/ /spre'u lo dgung lo bdun cu rtsa dgu la skyid grong du byon nas khrid pa mang po la phyag rgya chen po lhan skyes sbyor gyi khrid gnang bas/ rtogs pa shar ba mang du byung bas khrid lo legs 'dug /ngas khrid btab pa rnams la byin rlabs kyi nyams tshan che la/ phyis kyang rtogs pa ngo 'phrod pa re yong bar 'dug /lar skyes pas mi chog skyong dgos/ ma bskyangs na rgyal po dmangs su 'bab pa yin/ skyong ba la bla ma la gsol ba 'debs shing*/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa 'khor yug tu 'dzin pa yin/ zla ba gcig bsgoms pas rang gi shes pa ma bcos pa chos kyi sku ngo 'phrod pa'i khrid ka 'di 'dra ba gzhan na med/ gsang 'dus rim lnga 'ang rgyud sde'i dgongs pa yin mod kyang*/ rtogs pa 'di ltar ngo 'phrod pa dka'o/ /da lo chos gang zhu ba tsho byed pa yin pas zhus zhig gsungs nas/ phyag rgya chen po/ bsnyen sgrub/ chos drug /ro snyoms la sogs pa du ma gnang*/ mos gus dang byams khrid la sogs pa khrid chen bdun po rnams kyang gnang ngo*/ gzhan yang gang zhus pa la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin gnang ngo*/

/da ni gdams pa'i rtsad gcod ran zhes pa'i brdar/ u rgyan pa la rgas pa mi yong snyam pa yin te/ rgas pa de'ang 'byung gda' gsung ngo*// de nas spud trar phebs pa'i tshe gar zha ba don grub mdzes la sang phod go lung du thab kha 'deg pas shing mang du sogs gsungs/ de nas cung bar spyan drangs byon pas 'di pa tsho mos gus che bas nga khams bzang bar 'dug gsungs nas bde mchog gi dbang bskur yang gnang ngo*/ /de nas nyin gcig grub chen rin po che'i zhal nas/ spud tra na sgom chen pa mang po 'tshogs nas gros dang 'dun ma mang po byed cing 'dug /de mi rgan zhig la nga na nyen yod gsungs so/ /gsung de lta bu mi gnang ba zhu byas pas/ dam tshig gi sel 'di thub cig gda' gsungs/ de nas spud trar phebs pa'i tshe/ bsnyung zug sogs med kyang*/ sku shed chung du song*/ de'i tshe skye ba 'dzin pa la gang dga' ba yin gsungs/ slob dpon gzhon nu 'bum na re/ dga' ldan dga' pa ma lags sam/ zhus pas/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam stong pa nyid dang snying rje ro mnyam pa rgyud la skye ba la/ gdul bya khams drug dang ldan pa mi'i lus phun sum tshogs pa zhig dgos pa yin/ de'i phyir nga kun rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul lam/ sham bha la kun dga' 'am snyam gsungs/ bla ma lha rje pak+shis/ rje grub thob chen po la sku la snyung zug mi mnga' yang*/ sku shed chung bar gda' bas/ bdag cag rnams 'jigs par gda'/ grwa pa bu slob sgrub pa po rnams la zhal mjal zhig zhus na thugs la btags sam zhus pas/ de bzhin mdzod gsung nas thams cad kyis phyag skor byas/ phyag rgyun phul byin rlabs zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ rang sems chos skur rtogs na bla ma sangs rgyas dang 'bral ba med pa yin pas/ khyed thams cad tshe 'di blos thong la/ sgrub pa tshul bzhin du gyis/ bla ma la gsol ba thob/ sems skye med kyi ngang la zhog la/ 'gag med la rtsal sbyongs/

de ltar byas na nga dang skad cig kyang 'bral ba med do gsungs/ de nas sa mo bya'i lo khrums kyi zla ba'i tshes nyi shu la/ rje 'gro ba'i mgon po grub chen rin po che de chos kyi dbyings su dgongs pa mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan no/ /de'i tshe gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la sogs pa nam mkhar lhags te/ rol mo'i sgra bsgrags shing 'od 'byin no/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun phab nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis 'khrigs par gyur to/ slob dpon gzhon tshul shri ri gnam ldang na yod pas/ bla ma dran nas ri rtser phyin pas spud tra'i gdong thams cad 'jas gang 'dug /de nas mtshan mo gsol ba btab pas bde gsal gyi ngang du mjal/ de ma thag tu sku de bu chung zhig tu gyur pa rgya gar bar 'dug pa snyam pa byung skad/ de nas nyi shu lnga'i nyin par bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su/ tsan+dan dang sman sna tshogs pa'i zhugs la sku'i snang ba brtul nas/ sku gdung ring bsrel gyi snang bar gyur to/ /de'i dus su 'ja' 'od dang rol mo'i sgras nam mkha' gang bar gyur cing*/ gshegs rdzongs dbus gtsang gi 'brel yod thams cad du rgya chen po dang*/ go lung du bstan gtso'i sku gser las bzhengs pa sogs rten bzhengs kyang du ma mdzad do// de ltar grub chen o rgyan pa'i rnam thar 'di ni rin po che mkhar chu ba/ sems dpa' chen po gser khang pa/ snye mdo kun dga' don grub/ snye mo shākya 'od/ go lung pa gzhon nu dpal sogs kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar gung bsres te/ rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rnam thar sogs las mdo tsam btus nas bkod pa'o// ༈¿¿rje de la bu slob dpag tu med pa byon pa las gtso bor gyur pa ni/ rtsod med kyi sprul sku rje rang byung rdo rje/ gzhan snye mdo pa sku mched/ g.ya' bzang gi chos rje drin chen mkhar chu ba/ glang 'khor gyi 'jam dbyangs bsod nams 'od zer te yongs grags kyi sras bzhi/

a lung pa 'jam dbyangs rdo rje/ 'bri gung chos blo/ mus sku zhang pa/ lha rje pak+shi/ me shel ba/ mkha' 'gro phug pa ba/ mkhan po sgrub rin/ gdan sa pa ste nye ba'i bu brgyad/ snye mo grwa pa/ tsha chung ba/ g.yag mgo ba/ zla seng pa ste mchog tu gyur pa bzhi/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang dzo ki mang po/ a re dga'/ zur phug pa/ shan+ti ras pa/ ra ca/ rgya ri ba sogs rtogs ldan dpag med dang*/ chag lo bstan 'dzin dpal/ shong lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ lha btsun ye shes 'od sogs so/ /slob ma de dag kyang so sor mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rnam pa thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'dug kyang*/ 'dir smos kyis mi langs so//
